extension.summary: 显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news: v1.9.8.1 - Merged upstream v1.9.8 onto the custom base. - Retired custom ppicodecs channel-layout blocks: upstream 1.9.8 now ships a native equivalent for all three variants (SDR wide, HDR wide, and a dedicated DV top-right panel with its own horizontal offset), themed via the ChannelBackgroundColor / ChannelLayoutColor / ChannelIconColor settings. The custom XML has been removed to avoid duplicate graphics; enable Show speaker layout per variant in the Overlay settings to see them. - Re-applied ui/fonts.py: NotoSans filename fix and update-in-place same-name Font.xml rewriting. - Re-applied ui/overlay.py: settings-click on remote OK/Select and mouse/touch on the header chart icon; upstream arrow-key nudge and the new DV channel offset both preserved. - NOTE: still requires tools.tinyppi 1.1.4 (unchanged).
